736:t_2:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come now... The time has come for us to become one.」

736:t_2:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「N-No... Could it be!? Just as they said, you absorbed $$サクリファイ$$!」

736:t_2:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is the only way to save the universe.」

736:t_2:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Will that stop the universe's great collapse!?」

736:t_2:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There's no need to do anything like that.」

736:t_2:13.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「W-What are you talking about!?」

736:t_2:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The universe must be reborn.」

736:t_2:15.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What are you saying, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

736:t_2:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, let us become one, $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$. You will be eternal within me.」

736:t_2:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「T-That means... $$テンプティ$$ is going to vanish, doesn't it!」

736:t_2:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There is nothing to fear. Your soul will live on within me.」

736:t_2:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「N-No! Stay away, don't come near me!」

736:t_2:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Why, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!? Were we not eternal beings who had risen above both lies and strife!」

736:t_2:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Enough of words that only sound pleasing, $$ドクトリン$$. You committed the grave sin of casting me out.」

736:t_2:22.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It was then that I understood. That even beings such as the $$御使い$$s were not enough to save the universe.」

736:t_2:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I returned and tested whether you were worthy of saving the universe, but it ended in disappointment.」

736:t_2:25.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Disappointment... You mean we failed!?」

736:t_2:26.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why we become one... For the sake of the Supreme God's rebirth, too.」

736:t_2:27.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Rebirth!? But we only have eight $$スフィア$$s together!」

736:t_2:28.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Unless all of the $$スフィア$$s are gathered, the Supreme God will...!」

736:t_2:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That you did nothing about it was your negligence. I spent 12,000 years searching for a way to overcome it.」

736:t_2:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The four missing $$スフィア$$s will be made up for by the three of you and $$アサキム$$.」

736:t_2:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To do that, I needed to take your power from you, even if only temporarily. They performed that great task admirably.」

736:t_2:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... I have been guiding $c for this very day.」

736:t_2:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And then I will become the Supreme God itself, and save the universe reborn.」

736:t_2:36.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I-I'm sorry! I'm sorry, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Forgive me for what happened 12,000 years ago!」

736:t_2:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「God does not allow it.」

736:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well then, we barely managed to escape, but even I can't tell what will happen next.」

736:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The only thing I can say for certain is that the next battle will be the true final battle.」

736:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The days I have fought alongside all of you... I, AG, will never forget them.」

736:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「These 2000 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$ are those feelings given form... I'll add them to the unit's stock, so please use them as you see fit.」

736:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then... this is the last $$Ｄトレーダー$$. As befits a final sale, I'll go all out!」

736:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Giving it everything to the very end... Business, business!」

737:t_000:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「On our Earth, this is where $$ラース・バビロン$$ was.」

737:t_000:2.en:
$$桂$$
「I can feel it. The air of something seriously bad...」

737:t_000:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is that the source of it...!」

737:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I can sense an overwhelming power that truly deserves that name.」

737:t_001:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... I believe the sun of this $$カオス・コスモス$$ was transformed into that $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

737:t_001:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「A star is a lump of $$次元力|lc$$...」

737:t_001:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If Earth is where the power of the universe's especially strong stars is gathered, then naturally the Sun must be the same.」

737:t_001:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then that thing is like a device for the $$御使い$$s to draw out $$次元力$$...!」

737:t_002:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is just as you sense. That is what will become the new Supreme God.」

737:t_002:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have been waiting for you all.」

737:t_003:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So you finally showed up, you lackeys!」

737:t_003:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Looks like they're holding nothing back, as befits a decisive battle!」

737:t_003:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I would rather you not think this is the full extent of our strength.」

737:t_003:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though some of our forces have been dispatched to each of the universes.」

737:t_003:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「To destroy humanity as it tries to evolve!?」

737:t_003:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No, that is not it. It is to stop the universe's great collapse.」

737:t_003:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「What do you mean, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

737:t_003:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You have no need to know. Now, let us begin.」

737:t_003:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is it impatience? He seems strangely hurried, for him...)

737:t_003:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If that's how you want it, then we...!」

737:t_003:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... There seems to be no ending between you and me but this one.」

737:t_003:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What a shame. I did love you all, you know.」

737:t_003:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「For the sake of $$アサキム$$ and $$サクリファイ$$, too, I'll take you down!」

737:t_003:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief! I'm leaving the rest to you!」

737:t_003:16.en:
$n
「Time to settle this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! For Dad, Mom, and Sis...! And for myself!」

737:t_003:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is as it should be, $n. After all, it was for this day that I gave you all those trials.」

737:t_003:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But you end here! Taste for yourselves the power of an $$御使い$$ who holds all eight $$スフィア$$s!」

737:t_004:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Impossible...! Both I and $$ヘリオース$$...!」

737:t_004:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have gathered all eight $$スフィア$$s! And yet...!」

737:t_004:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Roger! Leave the rest to us!」

737:t_003:15: Crowe's 後の事は頼むぜ: addressee Chief = Traia; 'the rest' left unspecified
737:t_003:4: Banjo's line has no subject (Advent's forces), kept impersonal

736:t_2:12: referent of そんな事をする必要はない not fully settled
737:t_003:0: しもべ共 rendered 'lackeys' (Simon sneering at the Angels)
